goal: Retrieve web-2's CMDB inventory record to establish its role, criticality, owner, and declared trust edges for context.
what_to_summarize: web-2 role assignment in CMDB
web-2 criticality level
web-2 owner/team
web-2 declared trust_edges_out (what hosts/zones it can reach)
web-2 users block if present
Whether web-2 is expected to receive inbound SSH connections per its inventory profile

goal: Check whether any successful sshd authentication occurred on web-2 in a 30-minute window around the failed-auth burst, which would indicate possible compromise.
what_to_summarize: Any sshd 'Accepted' events on web-2 between 19:45-20:15 UTC on 2026-07-26
For each Accepted event: username, source IP (from raw message), auth method, timestamp
Relative timing of any successful auth vs the failed-auth burst window (19:52-19:55)
Total count of Accepted sshd events on web-2 in this window

params.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:45:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:15:00Z"
        AND host.name == "web-2"
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
        AND event.outcome == "success"
| EVAL auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*publickey*", "publickey",
                          message LIKE "*password*", "password", "other")
| KEEP @timestamp, user.name, source.ip, auth_method, message
| SORT @timestamp ASC

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:45:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:15:00Z"
        AND host.name == "web-2"
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
        AND event.outcome == "failure"
| STATS failed_count = COUNT(*)
| KEEP failed_count

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:45:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:15:00Z"
        AND host.name == "web-2"
        AND message LIKE "*Accepted*"
| STATS accepted_count = COUNT(*)
| KEEP accepted_count

goal: Extract raw sshd failed-auth events on web-2 in the alert window to determine source IP(s), usernames attempted, timing pattern, and auth methods from the raw message field.
what_to_summarize: Distinct source IP addresses in sshd Failed password events on web-2 between 19:50-20:00 UTC
Distinct usernames attempted in the Failed password messages
Timing distribution of the 96 failures (burst pattern, cadence, gaps)
Auth method tokens in the raw messages (password vs publickey vs other)
Sample raw message lines showing the format
Baseline: count of sshd Failed events on web-2 in the 24h before the alert window for comparison

params.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:50:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:00:00Z"
  AND host.name == "web-2"
  AND event.outcome == "failure"
  AND process.name == "sshd"
| STATS failures = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
    BY source.ip, user.name, auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*publickey*", "publickey",
                                                message LIKE "*password*", "password", "other")
| SORT failures DESC

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:50:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:00:00Z"
  AND host.name == "web-2"
  AND event.outcome == "failure"
  AND process.name == "sshd"
| STATS failures = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp),
        sample_msg = MIN(message)
    BY minute = DATE_TRUNC(1 minute, @timestamp)
| SORT minute

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-25T19:50:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T19:50:00Z"
  AND host.name == "web-2"
  AND event.outcome == "failure"
  AND process.name == "sshd"
| STATS failures = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-25T19:50:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T19:50:00Z"
  AND host.name == "web-2"
  AND event.outcome == "failure"
  AND process.name == "sshd"
  AND message LIKE "*Failed password*"
| STATS failures = COUNT(*)

goal: Identify what host or container is associated with IP 172.18.0.6 by searching for any events in Elastic that reference this IP — auth logs, Zeek connection logs, Zeek SSH logs, or other data streams.
what_to_summarize: Any events in logs-system.auth-* referencing 172.18.0.6 as source or rhost on any host (not just web-2)
Zeek SSH log entries (logs-zeek.ssh-*) for connections from 172.18.0.6 to web-2 in the alert window
Zeek connection log entries (logs-zeek.connection-*) involving 172.18.0.6 around the alert time
Any other log streams referencing 172.18.0.6 that could identify the host/container behind this IP
Whether 172.18.0.6 appears as source.ip in any nginx access logs or other service logs

params.query:
FROM logs-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:50:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:00:00.000Z"
        AND (source.ip == "172.18.0.6" OR client.ip == "172.18.0.6" OR host.ip == "172.18.0.6")
| STATS events     = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY host.name, data_stream.dataset
| SORT events DESC

FROM logs-zeek.*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:50:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:00:00.000Z"
        AND (source.ip == "172.18.0.6" OR destination.ip == "172.18.0.6")
| STATS events = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY data_stream.dataset, source.ip, destination.ip, destination.port
| SORT events DESC

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:50:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:00:00.000Z"
        AND (source.ip == "172.18.0.6" OR client.ip == "172.18.0.6")
| STATS events = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY host.name, event.outcome, process.name
| SORT events DESC

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:50:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:00:00.000Z"
        AND source.ip == "172.18.0.6"
| STATS events = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY host.name, event.outcome, process.name
| SORT events DESC

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:50:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:00:00.000Z"
        AND host.ip == "172.18.0.6"
| STATS events = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY host.name, data_stream.dataset
| SORT events DESC

FROM logs-nginx.access-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:50:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:00:00.000Z"
        AND (source.ip == "172.18.0.6" OR client.ip == "172.18.0.6")
| STATS events = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY host.name

FROM logs-nginx.access-*

        AND source.ip == "172.18.0.6"
| STATS events = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY host.name
| SORT events DESC

FROM logs-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:50:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:00:00.000Z"
        AND host.ip == "172.18.0.6"
